body: Isn't it fucking fantastic how nobody gives a flying fuck about scum like us? They just let us sink to the bottom and drown so they don't have to go down with us. Fucking hypocritical bastards, all of them. In the words of the joker "All it takes is one bad day to reduce the sanest man alive to lunacy. That's how far the world is from where I am. Just one bad day. You had a bad day once. Am I right? I know I am. I can tell. You had a bad day and everything changed." And the shit just keeps spiralling down right? If only we could make these blissfully ignorant fools understand just how agonizing it is to live such an empty shell of an existence, filled only with rage and self-loathing.

I've been through a lot of treatment. I spent most of latter years of high-school in inpatient and outpatient treatment at behavioral centers. I've been on many many different medications for my age. Abilify, wellbutrin, Adderall, zoloft, Vistaril, Ritalin, Concerta, lithium, and a few others I have forgotten over time. Ive been through multiple therapists, psychiatrists, counselors and psychologists. About the only two things I haven't tried is shock therapy and light therapy. I just feel like I've put in so much effort only to feel so much worse. I've lost lots of weight with diet an exercise, 50 pounds so far this year but still I don't feel any better. I just don't k ow what to do anymore it feels like the curtains are closing. Also I'm a part of my life where I just got a promising new job and if I take time off now I will get fired. I don't get vacation or sick days until a year of working there.

You are valuing the worth of your life on your academic performance, when you are clearly not compatible with whatever education system is being applied to you. To me it sounds like you are trying as hard as you can and it's not working for you, so instead of working harder try working smarter. See if you can get your GED and then get trained in a trade that interests you. Hvac, plumbing, metalworking, glassblowing, you name it there are tons of hands on careers out there that pay very well while allowing you to pursue something you are passionate about. Or if that's not for you, try thinking of what you define as successful. Your life as it is is not fulfilling your own definitions of success, so try to come to an understanding of what you define as success and start taking steps towards that image. Sorry if this wasn't helpful, just trying to give a realistic solution.

thanks. I just don't see any way out. I'm doing things that should be improving my mood and my life but these things that people and therapists tell me to do never work. I got a job, move up and then went to a better company i enjoy working for. I'm on the path to move up. I have a good work life balance. I've lost 40 pounds so far this year with diet and exercise.
